chunks: Thus the word of your Lord about those who disobey comes true, that they do not believe.

key_terms.حَقَّتْ: Has come to pass / become due

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'word of your Lord' mean in Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to 'divine decree' (hujjah) rather than mere compulsion, indicating that persistent rejection of truth hardens the heart, making belief impossible. It underscores the principle that divine promise is fulfilled when the disbelievers, having exhausted their free will, choose to remain in their deviation. This reflects the balance between God's foreknowledge and human agency in the journey to faith.
